646:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh my~ Mr. $$勝平$$, you were magnificent, standing up to the great evil of the universe! I, $$ＡＧ$$... am so moved I'm at a loss for words!」

646:t_10:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「You think so? Then why don't you try fighting too?」

646:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, even if you tell me that... $$バンドック$$ no longer exists, you see...」

646:t_10:11.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$バンドック$$ may be gone, but I've got this guy! $$千代錦$$, take him on!」

646:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah! This isn't $$バンドック$$, it's Wandog!」

646:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Eek~ The d-drool is soaking my lovable body~!」

646:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well, Lord $$ゼウス$$! Welcome to such a cramped place!」

646:t_10:22.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Spare me the stiff greetings. From today, I am one of your companions, after all.」

646:t_10:24.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Mm... A newcomer has only to follow your ways.」

646:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's give it our all again today...!」

646:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! Thank you for the powerful call!」

646:t_10:28.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Now, to the main subject. What are you?」

646:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe I answered this before, but I'm an agent robot of $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$...」

646:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Not that such an answer would work on you, I suppose.」

646:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Stop right there. I do not like being the subject of anyone's pronouncements about what I am.」

646:t_10:33.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「...Understood. I apologize for my rudeness.」

646:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your understanding is all I ask. I'm sorry for being so selfish, too.」

646:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But no matter what, I simply can't bring myself to like gods throwing their weight around... that's just how I am...)

647:t_000:0.en:
$$號$$
「Looks like we made it back to normal space.」

647:t_000:2.en:
$$渓$$
「It feels similar to the galactic core we came to before, but...」

647:t_000:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right. This location is about 1,000 light-years from the galactic center.」

647:t_000:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In addition, every ship except the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ has been confirmed safe within a 2,000 km radius.」

647:t_000:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well, that's a relief for now.」

647:t_000:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. At this distance, regrouping will be quick, and...」

647:t_000:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We should also be able to reach the galactic center in a few hyperspace jumps.」

647:t_000:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「The problem will be attacks from the $$御使い$$s, I suspect.」

647:t_000:9.en:
$$桂$$
「I never thought they'd come at us in hyperspace.」

647:t_000:10.en:
$$隼人$$
「With their supernatural power, something like that is probably only natural for them.」

647:t_000:14.en:
$n
「A lot has happened and I still haven't sorted it all out, but this has made the situation simple.」

647:t_000:15.en:
$n
「The enemy we have to defeat is called the $$御使い$$s... And $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was one of them, too... That's all there is to it.」

647:t_000:16.en:
$n
(Dad, Sis... and Mom... I'll do it, even if it costs me my life...)

647:t_000:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「No matter how powerful the $$御使い$$s are, Earth is protected by $$スヴェル$$. All that's left is for us to hit them.」

647:t_000:19.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But we know far too little about the $$御使い$$s.」

647:t_000:20.en:
$$タケル$$
「Higher-dimensional life forms... The superiors of the $$サイデリアル$$ who manage humanity's evolution... Beings with the power to destroy even galaxies using $$次元力$$...」

647:t_000:21.en:
$$隼人$$
「Going by what $$ハーデス$$, $$ズール$$, and the rest said, they're hostile to the villains who call themselves gods, too, and they seem to have even greater power than them.」

647:t_000:22.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Thanks to the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, we found out the $$宇宙怪獣$$' nest is at the galactic center, but we still don't even know where those guys are...」

647:t_000:23.en:
$$シモン$$
「But they know our every move. If this keeps up, we'll just be on the receiving end of one-sided attacks.」

647:t_000:24.en:
$$セツコ$$
「And... it's not as if Earth is absolutely safe, either...」

647:t_000:25.en:
$$シン$$
「It's all right, $$セツコ$$. Earth is protected by $$スヴェル$$.」

647:t_000:26.en:
$$キラ$$
「But... if the galaxy itself were destroyed, I can't believe it would come out safe...」

647:t_000:27.en:
$$葵$$
「The galaxy destruction they put on display for us, huh...」

647:t_000:28.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Quite a demonstration. Wrecking a whole galaxy just to show off their power...」

647:t_000:29.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If that power gets used on the galaxy we're in...」

647:t_000:30.en:
$$勝平$$
「No matter how strong that $$スヴェル$$ thing is, there's no way to stop that, right...」

647:t_000:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's all right. For now, at least...」

647:t_000:33.en:
$$トライア$$
「If they could use that kind of power, they'd have crushed the galaxy long ago... or at least Earth.」

647:t_000:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But they haven't actually done it... We should take that as a sign that there's some reason they can't carry out the galaxy's destruction.」

647:t_000:35.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「They said that 'the preparations are complete.' In other words, the preparations for crushing this galaxy and Earth must not be finished yet.」

647:t_000:38.en:
$$トライア$$
「No use thinking about what we can't know. For now, all we can do is head for the galactic center.」

647:t_000:39.en:
$$渓$$
「Let's hurry. The new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 is also heading for the center, separately from us.」

647:t_000:40.en:
$$凱$$
「Right! Let's link up with the $$クォーター$$ at the center and smash the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

647:t_000:41.en:
$$號$$
「And it seems whoever wants to stop us from getting there has arrived...!」

647:t_001:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「We come out into the galaxy and get a welcoming party right away!」

647:t_001:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Units that are ready will sortie first! Hurry!」

647:t_002:1.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「We welcome you for breaking through the Angels' trap and setting foot in the heart of the galaxy!」

647:t_002:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Bring it on! We came here prepared to fight you, too!」

647:t_002:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Do not be hasty, Earthlings. We did not come here to fight.」

647:t_002:6.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Earthlings, we acknowledge your strength. Now is the time to join hands and fight $$バアル$$ and the $$御使い$$s together!」

647:t_002:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You mean to join forces with us?」

647:t_002:8.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Just so, younger brothers of the galaxy. We have been waiting for this day.」

647:t_002:9.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Higher-dimensional life forms... those who have become gods, that is, are charged with guiding immature species.」
